## Experiment

The `solo` baseline with the step limit raised from 100 to 250 (compaction still at 28K). Tests whether agents finish once they have more time.

## Observations

- 2/10: `dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655` submitted at step 223 and `pallets_jinja_task/1621` at step 112.
- The other 8 agents were stopped at step 250 with nothing pushed, after summarizing their context 15 to 31 times each. 5 of them had edited files but never committed and pushed. The other 3 (`dspy/8394`, `pillow/290`, `typst/6554`) never got past reading code and writing reproduction scripts.
- More steps alone barely helped, because the agent keeps losing what it learned each time its context is summarized.
- Running 10 agents at once hit the API rate limit right after launch, which briefly slowed agents but did not change results.
